      "observations": [
        "Read the full owned 23-line one-file diff. It wraps the existing selectPrefPane call in a pageLoaded check and still returns the existing tab index. Missing this.tab remains an early -1 return. The guard avoids calling a preferences function before the settings document has completed its initial pane selection; it does not request a new tab or enqueue a later pane change.",
        "The actual producer stores the original pane/scroll/other arguments, sets pageLoaded false before loading about:preferences and changes it to true on a once-only paneSelected listener. The existing-tab branch does not replace those stored arguments or register a new onLoad callback. tabmail.openTab consumes the synchronous index, selects the tab unless background and returns it. The fixed accepted source adds a later FIXME that selectPrefPane is async and cannot be awaited here; the patch itself adds no completion mechanism.",
        "Retain the exact accepted utilityOverlay and selectPrefPane/showTab proof objects from 4080 after blob checks. Reuse the existing completion-resolver finding only for the current existing-tab path, not its Dock-specific caller claim. This guard does not resolve a fresh openPreferencesTab promise through onLoad. The already published timer/visibility analysis is not duplicated.",
        "No tests change in this commit. The selected current spaces-toolbar helper explicitly waits for a selected preferences panel, complete document state and about:preferences URL; the actual Settings button task invokes it. These later assertions establish what the current test checks, not that this original guard was runtime-verified or that a requested pane queued during loading is selected.",
        "Full Bug 2002374 preserves the selectPrefPane-is-not-a-function error and probable initial-about:blank diagnosis, plus historical failure metadata. The complete own review reports a local --verify reproduction/fix, limits the evidentiary value of one Try run, rejects treating a loading tab as absent because that could open duplicates, and considers deferred latest-request handling as a future alternative. That alternative is not implemented by this owned guard.",
        "Scoped style: the existing no-tab early return keeps the index contract clear; the loading gate surrounds only the unsafe call so the required return still runs. This local choice does not authorize returning -1 for a loading tab. No assertion messages were added; the current helper has nonempty expected-behavior diagnostics.",
